title: The listener stays behind
alt: A low, solitary seismic instrument stands in lunar twilight. A large conceptual cross-section beneath it shows a wave traveling through layers of ground.
context: The deployed seismic package remained after the crew left. The subsurface bands and wave are explanatory, not a geological section inferred specifically from this instrument alone.
interpretation: Original story illustration. Viewpoint, lighting, pose, geometry and apparent distances are interpretive. Scientific arrows, waves, cutaways and displays explain principles; they are not recorded telemetry, a literal instrument diagram or a historical photograph.

sources.label: NASA · The seismometer detects the crew’s footsteps
